name: EvictionManager

test_list.description: The manager visits real slots in descending idle age with deterministic name tie breaking.
Critical memory pressure requests bounded drain on each slot and leaves admissions paused until explicit resume.
Elevated memory pressure applies the slot idle policy without forcing active leases.
Every slot receives a shutdown request even after the shared wait budget is exhausted.
Manager construction rejects duplicate, empty, control-containing and overlong names.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Idle, memory pressure, heavy build or shutdown trigger.

inputs.name: budget
inputs.description: One overall wait budget for the ordered requests.

output_description: Per-slot outcomes in trigger order, retaining errors and pending/in-use results.
